symbolDescription: Properties of one country in the countries dataset.

optionDescriptions.id: Stable key, ISO A3 where the dataset has one, otherwise the name.
optionDescriptions.name: English name.
optionDescriptions.isoA2: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or null where the dataset has none.
optionDescriptions.isoA3: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, or null where the dataset has none.
optionDescriptions.labelLat: Dataset-provided label anchor latitude; null falls back to the computed centroid.
optionDescriptions.labelLng: Dataset-provided label anchor longitude; null falls back to the computed centroid.
optionDescriptions.labelPriority: Lower sorts first when labels collide.
optionDescriptions.names: The name in other languages, keyed by language subtag ('de', 'ro'). `name` is used where a language is missing.
